scope: Final finite re-read of exact HTTP allowlist and typed event rejection only. No implementation source was edited.

findings.defect: createEventJournal accepts an injectable now callback but does not validate its return value before storing it as occurred_at. The exported DTO can therefore contain an arbitrary object instead of a timestamp string.
findings.expected: record rejects a non-string/non-ISO occurred_at value, or the construction API prevents an untyped clock from entering the DTO.
findings.actual: Exit 0; export contains occurred_at:{untyped:'value'} while schema, mode, action and sequence remain otherwise fixed.
findings.minimal_fix_direction: Validate the clock output at record time before event construction and reject an invalid value; add a semantic negative test alongside the existing free-form action tests.
findings.acceptance_limit: This defect is local DTO-type drift. It does not create a provider call, network effect, real income, or arbitrary action payload transfer.

confirmed_no_change.repro: Direct allowed_path calls returned None for .git, audit, seed, ordinary/encoded/double-encoded traversal; query on an already allowed canonical page resolved to that canonical path.
confirmed_no_change.limit: No HTTP server was started; this is an allowlist-function result, not browser or deployment certification.

test_gap.gap: Tests reject free-form action input but do not test that the injected now callback produces a string timestamp.
